intro: One new table and two routes. Each route sits in its own Contract, so the front and the back can be built at the same time.
worthALook: The unique pending invite per e-mail and workspace is a database constraint.
latitude: The order of fields in the responses.

contracts.returns: the pending invite, or the pending list
contracts.errors: invalid e-mail, already a member, not an admin

tables.name: invites
tables.holds: one invite: e-mail, workspace, hashed token, status, expiry

migrations: One migration adds the `invites` table and its unique index. It only adds, so rolling back is dropping the table.
